content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Lottery quick pick numbers mirror dates I’m thinking of. It keeps happening.
Quick picks are random within the game’s range. Of recent tickets, how many had at least one number overlapping with your thought dates?
Four tickets out of ten had a month or day match.
Months and days are common numbers within typical ranges. A record of total drawn numbers vs. overlaps across more tickets can show how often matches occur by chance.
I’ll keep a tally for the next dozen tickets.
Separating exact matches from near matches (±1) gives a clearer picture of how broad the overlap is.
